Title: Eagle sight cancelled by I am legion, while Tenebrous form is in play

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
The follwoing situation:

Azaneal annouces an bleed
Preys announces a block
Azaneal plays tenebrous form Superior
Prey declines to block
Predator plays Eagle Sight superior with Alexandra, wich forces a block attempt
Azaneal plays "I am legion" to cancel Eagle sight

is the blood still burned?

All I could find so far is that Hazimel/Enrage announce cost is paid after "as played", but sicne these are Actions, these might be different then for Modifiers and Reactions.
groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/07gUFmSeIxU/m/yIrwcMsATB4J

Tenebrous Form

[Obtenebration]
+1 stealth.
[Superior Obtenebration]
As above, and minions without Obtenebration [Obtenebration]
must burn 1 blood to attempt to block (allies cannot burn blood).

Eagle Sight

[Auspex]
+1 intercept.
[Superior Auspex]
This vampire attempts to block the current action, ignoring the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking actions.

I am Legion

[Daimoinon]
+1 stealth.
[Daimoinon]
[Obfuscate]
Cancel a reaction card requiring Auspex [Auspex]
as it is played (cost must be paid).
[Superior Daimoinon]
[Superior Obfuscate]
As [Daimoinon]
[Obfuscate]
above, and/or gain 1 pool after action resolution if this action is successful.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> The follwoing situation:
>
> Azaneal annouces an bleed
> Preys announces a block
> Azaneal plays tenebrous form Superior
> Prey declines to block
> Predator plays Eagle Sight superior with Alexandra, wich forces a block attempt
> Azaneal plays "I am legion" to cancel Eagle sight
>
> is the blood still burned?
>
Yes. Burning blood to attempt to block is part of the (additional) cost of playing Eagle's Sight.
And I am Legion doesn't refund the cost.
